description: This source file implements link-time checks for uniforms and resource management in a graphics shader program, including validation, resource limits, and interface block linking.

classes.name: InterfaceBlockInfo
classes.description: Manages interface block information, including sizes and layout, for shader resource blocks.

classes.name: UniformLinker
classes.description: Handles linking of uniforms, validation, and resource limit checks for shader programs.

classes.name: ProgramLinkedResources
classes.description: Stores linked resource data such as interface blocks, uniforms, and buffers.

classes.name: ProgramLinkedResourcesLinker
classes.description: Coordinates linking of resources like interface blocks and buffers between shaders.

classes.name: InterfaceBlockLinker
classes.description: Base class for linking interface blocks, managing active status and definitions.

classes.name: UniformBlockLinker
classes.description: Specializes InterfaceBlockLinker for uniform blocks, managing their linkage.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockLinker
classes.description: Specializes InterfaceBlockLinker for shader storage blocks.

classes.name: AtomicCounterBufferLinker
classes.description: Links atomic counter buffers with their sizes.

methods.name: LinkValidateUniforms
methods.description: Validates uniform variables for consistency in type, binding, location, and offset.

methods.name: ValidateGraphicsUniformsPerShader
methods.description: Validates uniforms for a specific shader stage, extending linked uniforms if needed.

methods.name: GetMaximumShaderUniformVectors
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of uniform vectors supported for a shader type.

methods.name: GetUniformResourceNameString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the resource type of a uniform.

methods.name: GetUniformResourceLimitName
methods.description: Returns the resource limit name for a given shader type and uniform type.

methods.name: LogUniformsExceedLimit
methods.description: Logs an error when uniform resource limits are exceeded.

methods.name: getShaderBlockInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about shader interface blocks.

methods.name: getBlockSize
methods.description: Gets the size of a specified interface block.

methods.name: getBlockMemberInfo
methods.description: Retrieves layout info for a block member.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links resources such as interface blocks, buffers, and atomic counters based on shader program state.

methods.name: getAtomicCounterBufferSizeMap
methods.description: Calculates sizes for atomic counter buffers based on linked uniforms.
